basics.name: Tushar Kapoor
basics.label: AI/ML Engineering Student
basics.summary: B.Tech CSE (AI & ML) student with hands-on experience building AI/ML applications across cloud, IoT, LLM-based assistants, and data analysis. Works in Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Flask, and SQL. Completed two internships (AI & Cloud engineering; AI research and operations automation) and led technical teams on academic and international projects.

work.name: GO-BRICS Business Lab
work.position: Applied AI Research & Operations Automation Intern
highlights: Conducted international product and market research for business decision-making, using AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis and surface actionable insights.
Identified process-improvement opportunities and supported workflow optimisation on operations-automation projects.
Worked with cross-functional, multicultural teams in a global environment and delivered assigned tasks on schedule.
Received a Letter of Recommendation for performance.

work.name: Edunet Foundation (IBM · Shell · VOIS · VI)
highlights: Led a 4-member agile team as technical lead; built an AI chatbot on IBM Cloud and AWS with a Flask REST API backend.
Built predictive ML models and automation pipelines in Python, TensorFlow, and scikit-learn across two client project tracks.
Presented findings in 8 weekly sessions, turning model outputs into recommendations for the final project roadmap.

projects.name: AI-Powered Nutrition Assistant
projects.description: Agentic nutrition assistant on IBM watsonx.ai (Llama LLM) that gives personalised dietary recommendations from location, weather, and user preferences.

projects.name: EcoSphere — Environmental Intelligence Platform
projects.description: TensorFlow anomaly-detection pipeline on live IoT sensor streams via AWS IoT Core, with a real-time Streamlit dashboard. Presented at the K.R. Mangalam University AI Project Showcase, Mar 2025.

projects.name: Energy-O-Thon — International AI Hackathon
projects.description: Flask + TensorFlow energy-optimisation tool with a Streamlit dashboard showing consumption patterns and reduction tips, built with an international team across time zones.

projects.name: Business Data Analysis — Real-World Datasets
projects.description: Cleaned and analysed 3 business datasets (UCI ML Repository, 50,000+ records) in Python and R; built a Flask app presenting 12 insights and an inventory recommendation.
